common.tagline: Self-Hosted Fingerprinting, Bot Detection & Threat Intelligence

landing.heroSubtitle: The open-source alternative to FingerprintJS Pro & Cloudflare Turnstile. 48+ deterministic browser signals, anti-detect browser noise probes, JA4 TLS correlation, and an in-memory 54,000+ CIDR Radix Trie running entirely on your own infrastructure.
landing.liveWidgetSubtitle: Executed locally right now by @bloumeid/sdk with zero cookies and zero external tracking.
landing.archTitle: Built for Security Engineers, Not Marketers
landing.archSubtitle: Every component is auditable TypeScript with strict constant-time cryptography, Snowflake IDs, and zero runtime dependencies.
landing.bentoReconcileDesc: Reconciles visitors across Chrome, Firefox, and Safari even after cookie clears using browser-invariant GPU/Audio/Screen hardwareHash paired with /24 IPv4 and /48 IPv6 subnet correlation.
landing.bentoLevel2: Level 2: HardwareHash + /24 Subnet 30d window (88% cross-browser match)
landing.bentoLevel3: Level 3: Distributed 64-bit Snowflake vis_ assignment (95% confidence)
landing.bentoAntiSpoofDesc: Catches Multilogin, Dolphin Anty, AdsPower, Brave aggressive shield, Playwright, Puppeteer, and Selenium CDP via dual-pass Canvas/Audio rendering and Blob Web Worker thread comparison.
landing.bentoTrieTitle: In-Memory Patricia / Radix CIDR Threat Trie
landing.bentoTrieDesc: Ingests X4BNet VPN, Datacenter, Tor Bulk Exit lists, and MaxMind GeoLite2 MMDBs into a binary radix trie for sub-millisecond O(32) IP classification plus Redis sliding-window velocity checks.
landing.bentoCryptoDesc: Every client payload is signed with a single-use Redis-deduplicated nonce and ±5m timestamp window. Server verification uses SHA-256 hashed bid_sec_ keys compared with crypto.timingSafeEqual.
landing.compSubtitle: Keep 100% data sovereignty under GDPR/CNIL without paying per-API-call enterprise tolls.
landing.compRow1: 48+ Deterministic Signals (Canvas, WebGL2, WebGPU, Audio, Fonts)
landing.compRow4: In-Memory 54k+ CIDR VPN / Tor / Datacenter Radix Trie
landing.compRow5: JA4 TLS Fingerprint vs User-Agent Coherence Check
landing.compRow6: 100% Data Sovereignty (No data leaves your VPC)
landing.compRow7: Unlimited Events at Fixed Infrastructure Cost ($0/event)
landing.codeTitle: 100% ThumbmarkJS Pro Compatible API + Server Verification
landing.codeSubtitle: Migrate in 2 minutes using our zero-dependency NPM package or self-hosted UMD CDN endpoint.
landing.footerBuiltBy: Engineered by Bloume SAS • MIT Licensed Open-Source Software
